versions.name: Orienteering
versions.description: Take a bearing, orient a topographic map, and count your pace over a measured hundred meters, then race real control courses, set one of your own, and teach the technique to your patrol.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
